title: El Sastre de Zamora, MAJESTIC STORIES
comment: traje-zamora (MAJESTIC): sastrería antigua en el centro de Zamora, Michoacán. Caras comunes, no famosas; los tres se distinguen a simple vista.

chars.FULGENCIO_RANGEL: Mexican man, the powerful cacique of the region, 64 years old, tanned light skin, thick grey hair combed back, a grey goatee, heavy eyebrows, a white dress shirt with a black vest and a gold pocket-watch chain, black trousers, black polished boots, a gold ring, an old pale scar across the back of his right hand, his hands empty.
chars.ABUNDIO_TREVINO: Mexican man, old town tailor, 62 years old, light-brown skin, thin face, neatly combed grey hair, round wire-rimmed glasses, a brown knitted cardigan over a pale-blue shirt, grey trousers, a yellow measuring tape hanging around his neck, his hands empty.
chars.AMPARO_LEDESMA: Mexican woman, 58 years old, fair skin, elegant, shoulder-length chestnut hair with soft waves, delicate makeup, small gold earrings, a pale-rose silk dress with long sleeves, a cream shawl, beige heels, her hands empty.

locs.LOC_SASTRERIAZAMORA: Interior of an old tailor shop in the historic center of Zamora, Michoacán, in the afternoon: dark wooden counter, shelves with bolts of fabric, an antique black sewing machine, a dressmaker mannequin with a half-made black suit jacket, a tall standing mirror, warm sunlight through a tall window, a wooden front door with glass, no readable text, no signs, no logos, no people.
